title: Taiwan Launches US Industrial Park Program for Nvidia AI Supply Chain
summary:
The government in Taipei will provide loan guarantees and visa assistance to help smaller components makers relocate to a new $4B Texas facility. This project is the first of several intended industrial hubs in the US, each estimated to cost between $2B and $4B, to house auxiliary suppliers for TSMC and Foxconn as they shift production capabilities overseas.

The initiative seeks to establish a comprehensive domestic production base for Nvidia and other AI hardware producers within the US. Taipei has already secured land for the initial Texas complex as part of a broader effort to raise billions of dollars to facilitate the regional relocation of the AI semiconductor ecosystem.
